node.title: HGE4 near-third Kummer midpoint pencil
node.statement: For every near-third Belyi pair, the cyclotomic complement has W=ZS+lambda y^c and the midpoint satisfies S | 1-(1-a^2lambda)y^m. Over a finite base field containing mu_m, all midpoint factors have one Kummer degree d dividing h; if d>1 its Frobenius multiplier stabilizes both outside members, contradicting primitivity. Hence d=1 and the retained strip reduces to a base-field-split three-member divisor pencil at every width.
